skills.name: phoenix-labs
skills.description: Restore old video (tapes, DVDs, film scans, old phone clips) and turn still images into five-second video clips with sound, using the Phoenix Labs MCP server or REST API, paid from the user's prepaid balance with a capped agent key or in USDC over x402. Use when a user wants old footage cleaned up or upscaled, or a photo, logo or artwork animated into a short clip.
